document.abstract: The Sydney Olympic Broadcasting Organisation (SOBO), the Host Broadcaster for the Sydney 2000 Olympic Games, is responsible for orignating the coverage of the greatest television event on earth. A team from SOBO will describe the planning of the 3,200 hours of live sporting coverage and the design and construction of the International Broadcast Centre, for two months next year the largest broadcast centre in the world, home to 10,000 international broadcasters.
